description: Retrieval benchmark over Flask 3.1.3 (fixtures/flask). `tuned` queries were used while choosing weights/chunking; `tuned:false` queries were written first and held out. A query is a hit when a retrieved item matches any `expect` entry (path equal, symbol equal or, if given as a class/function name, a prefix of the chunk's qualified symbol). Modes: any-top3 = a match among the first 3 auto items; all-in-top8 = every expect entry matched within the first 8.

queries.query: Add a built-in CLI command `flask config` that prints the app config as JSON, masking the value of any key containing SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN, or KEY as "***". It must appear in `flask --help`, have a test, and be documented with the other built-in commands.
queries.note: Task B: code, test and docs must all surface without being named. cli.py counts when a chunk of FlaskGroup or routes_command is retrieved.

queries.query: make get_debug_flag treat 'off' and 'n' as false too, case-insensitively, and update the docstring to list every false value
queries.note: Task A as a panel prompt that names the function (in the inline editor the selection supplies the name).
